notes: ANNKE is a confirmed Hikvision OEM. Two documented path families exist: (1) /{codec}/ch{N}/{stream}/av_stream — ANNKE's primary path, documented in product user manuals (C500, AC500, 4K PoE) hosted on Amazon/ManualsLib; codec = H264 or H265; channel index is 1-based (ch1, ch2…); stream = main or sub; port 554. (2) /Streaming/Channels/{N}01 (main) / {N}02 (sub) — Hikvision ISAPI path, explicitly documented in ANNKE's own help.annke.com support articles for DVR/NVR RTSP setup and VLC configuration; channel ID formula: (channel × 100) + stream-type (1=main, 2=sub). For a single-channel IP camera: 101 (main), 102 (sub). The ANNKE Nova series uses the /H264/ch1/main/av_stream form. Many leads are cross-contaminated Foscam .sdp paths or generic ONVIF URIs. ANNKE cameras are sold primarily on Amazon and annke.com.
